name: inline-activity-loader
title: Inline Activity Loader
description: A tiny loader that sits inline with text to show an agent is working: 18 CSS figures (orbit, signal, glyph, snake, vortex, a count-up and more) sized in em by default.
author: Kasturi Khanke <https://github.com/kasturibuilds>
docs:
Installed `InlineActivityLoader` (`@/components/ui/inline-activity-loader`), with its CSS keyframes inside the file (React 19 hoists them into `` once). ```tsx import { InlineActivityLoader } from "@/components/ui/inline-activity-loader";

Searching the web

``` It is `1.15em` and `currentColor` by default, so it matches the text it sits in. Give it a `label` when no text next to it names the activity. Motion stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Ported from generative-loaders (`InlineLoader`) by Kasturi Khanke (MIT); the license notice is at the end of the file.
